children.issue: The paper states and proves Corollary 5.1 (the vertex- and arc-weighted forms of the conjecture, parts (i)–(iii) via Seacrest's equivalences). There is no counterpart anywhere in the Lean formalization, which only establishes the unweighted Theorem 1.1 (exists_goodVertex).

The paper states and proves Corollary 6.1 (non-neighbor bounds, the min in/out-degree ≥ n/3 directed-triangle consequence, and the girth-four order bound n ≥ 3r+1). The Lean formalization contains no definitions (Z(v), d±, directed 3-cycle, girth) or theorems corresponding to Section 6 at all.
